summary: Advances animation-track interpolation values across a linked list of animation nodes. For each node with flag bit 0x80000 set and a non-zero track count, walks its track entries and each track's entry array, moving the current value toward the target according to a loop-mode switch (1 wrap, 2 clamp, 3 ping-pong, 4 one-shot). On one-shot completion it clears a flag field on this via FlagFieldBitManipulation and resets the value to -1. Returns 0.

operations.description: Traverse the node linked list starting at this[129] (offset this+0x204), following the next-node pointer stored at node+16.
Skip the node unless its flag word at node+20 has bit 0x80000 set and its track count at node+280 is non-zero.
Iterate node-track-count times over the node's track entries; each track entry is 16 bytes and its base pointer is taken from node+284 plus 52.
Process a track's entry array only when the entry count at *(track_base)+164 is greater than 0.
Iterate over the entry array at *(track_base)+168; each entry is 148 bytes (37 dwords stride).
Skip the per-entry interpolation step when the entry field 8 bytes below the entry start is not greater than 1.
Apply the step only when the current value is below the target and the byte 16 bytes below the entry has bit 4 (completion) set.
Switch on the loop-mode field at entry+4 masked with 0xFFFF000F; the compiler jump table at 0x005504BC selects cases 1-4.
Cases 1-3 advance the current value toward the target with wrap (1), clamp (2), or ping-pong reversal at the target (3).
Case 4 (one-shot): on reaching the target, call FlagFieldBitManipulation(this, 0, 0, 1, 0), which clears a flag field on this (offset this+0x354), and reset the current value to -1.
Write the updated current value back to the track entry's current-value slot.
Return 0 after processing all list nodes.

clean_pseudocode: case 1: if (++cur >= tgt) cur = tgt - cur; break;
case 2: if (cur < tgt - 1) ++cur; if (cur >= tgt) cur = tgt - 1; break;
case 4: if (++cur >= tgt) { FlagFieldBitManipulation(this, 0, 0, 1, 0); cur = -1; } break;
